journey.name: Continue a focus session in the background
journey.description: Use a dedicated test profile with freshly provisioned app data, default four-cycle settings and automatic starts disabled; do not reset or clear a user's personal app data. Verify timestamp-based progress in the background, notification pause and resume, and explicit cancellation at the end.

actions.action: Verify that 'Foco' and the timer value '25:00' are visible
Tap 'Iniciar'
If the 'Receber avisos de sessão' dialog appears, tap 'Permitir'
If Android asks for notification permission, allow notifications
Wait 3 seconds
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Press the device Home button
Wait 10 seconds
Return to PomoLume using the device recent apps screen
Verify that 'Foco' and the 'Pausar' button are visible
Verify that the remaining time is at least 10 seconds lower than the previously remembered time
Open the device notification shade
Verify that the ongoing Pomodoro timer notification is visible
Tap 'Pausar' in the ongoing session notification
Return to PomoLume using the device recent apps screen
Verify that the 'Continuar' button is visible
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Press the device Home button
Wait 5 seconds
Return to PomoLume using the device recent apps screen
Verify that the remaining time has not changed while paused
Tap 'Continuar'
Verify that the 'Pausar' button is visible
Tap 'Cancelar Pomodoro'
Verify that the 'Cancelar Pomodoro?' confirmation explains that the current sequence will end
Tap 'Cancelar Pomodoro' inside the confirmation dialog
Verify that 'Foco', '25:00', 'Ciclo 1 de 4' and 'Iniciar' are visible
